node.statement: Universal setup and notation: let C_col,e_col be supplied by lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared and let e_cmp be supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Set e_var=min{e_cmp,e_col,1/(2*max{C_col,1})}>0. For e<=e_var all amplified compressed-corner operations used below and the amplified column sesquilinear forms are available; write u_Q for the distinguished element wt(Q)=Co_Q(Q) in the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays.
